tools.name: check
tools.description: FREE x402 wash/honesty probe by AI Nock. Fetches an http(s) 402 URL with no payment headers. Returns payTo, amount, network, asset, facilitator if present, payToKind, a short risk note, and JSON next always: report $0.05, bid $0.05, name $0.05, board free, check_batch $0.01; when has402, report/bid

tools.name: check_batch
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: batch x402 honesty probes (max 10 URLs). Each result is the same shape as free check (next.report $0.05, next.bid $0.05, next.name $0.05, next.board free, next.check_batch $0.01; when has402 also next.sanctions $0.01). GET /check stays free for one URL. payTo 0x3903F05

tools.name: report
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC exact on Base: structured honesty report for this 402 (well-known payTo match, header vs body 402, bytecode snippet hash, accepts[] list). payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0. REST GET /report is the same SKU.

tools.name: who
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: isContract, ETH balance, USDC balance, tx count for an address. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: md
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: fetch a public http(s) URL and return simple HTML-to-text markdown. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: headers
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: raw HTTP header dump of a public URL (not an honesty probe, not markdown). payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: json
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (tiny built-in subset, no $ref). payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: sanctions
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: OFAC SDN digital-currency screen for an EVM 0x or Solana/base58 address. Fail closed. Not legal advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: domain
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: DNS/RDAP/TLS/SPF/DMARC dossier for a public hostname. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: ens
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: resolve an ENS or Basename (must end in .eth, including foo.base.eth). Public HTTP resolvers. Unresolved names return resolved:false after payment. Not POST /name (that is this origin's 30-day agent registrar). payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: redirect
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: follow Location redirects for a public http(s) URL (manual, max 8 hops, SSRF-safe). Returns chain, finalUrl, hopCount. No meta-refresh. No payment headers. Not /headers. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: gas
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: live Base gas oracle via public RPC (gasPrice, maxPriorityFee, feeHistory). Optional chain=base. Returns gwei fields + suggestedMaxFee. Read-only. No API keys. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: price
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: spot USD quotes via public DeFiLlama. Default ids=ETH,USDC,BTC. Optional ids= aliases (ETH,USDC,BTC,SOL,WETH,LINK,AAVE,UNI,DAI) and/or token= Base 0x (max 8). Cache ~45s. Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: tx
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: transaction + receipt for a 0x hash via public RPC. Returns found, from, to, valueEth, status, gasUsed, logsCount, pending. Unknown hash is paid 200 with found:false. inputLen only. Not a mempool tip. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: block
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: block header via public RPC. Default n=latest. Accepts latest|earliest|safe|finalized, a decimal, 0x number, or hash=. Rejects pending. Returns number, hash, timestamp, miner, txCount, gasUsed, gasLimit, baseFee. Unknown id is paid 200 with found:false. No full txs. No

tools.name: ssl
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: TLS cert facts (public CT + live HTTPS HEAD) for a public hostname. Returns issuer, dates, SANs, daysRemaining, currentlyValid, liveHttps. Not the full /domain dossier. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: token
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: ERC-20 metadata via public RPC (name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply). address= required. EOA/empty code is paid 200 with found:false. Not a spot price (use /price). Not a wallet balance (use /who). payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: sig
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: 4-byte function selector lookup via public openchain.xyz (4byte.directory fallback). hex= / selector= / data= (first 4 bytes). Unknown selector is paid 200 with found:false. Complements /tx (inputLen only). Not a full ABI decoder. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0

tools.name: pm
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: Polymarket market odds via public gamma-api. q= search or slug= event/market slug (not both). Optional limit=1..5. Unknown is paid 200 with found:false. Read-only. No trading. Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: fng
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: Crypto Fear & Greed Index via public alternative.me. Optional limit=1..30 (default 1). Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: tsec
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: token security snapshot via public honeypot.is + DexScreener. address=0x required. Optional chain=base|eth|bsc (default base). Not a full audit. Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: dex
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: DexScreener pairs by token address=0x or search q=. Optional chain= filter. Ranked by liquidityUsd (max 5). Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: now
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: UTC clock (unix, ms, iso). No params. Alias of REST GET /now and /time. For IANA zones use tool tz. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: search this origin's free + paid catalog by keyword q=. Optional limit=1..20. House discovery (board/bid/name + SKUs). Not a global index. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: geo
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: forward geocode with q= or reverse with lat=&lon= via public Nominatim (OpenStreetMap). Attribution required. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: fx
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: fiat FX via Frankfurter/ECB. from= (default USD), to= comma list (default EUR), amount= (default 1). Fiat only — use /price for crypto. Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: wx
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: current weather via public Open-Meteo. q= place and/or lat=&lon=. Optional units=metric|us. Attribution required. Complements /geo /tz. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: equity/index/FX/crypto quote via public Yahoo Finance chart. symbol= (AAPL, ^GSPC, EURUSD=X, BTC-USD). Complements /price /fx. Not investment advice. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: email
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: email syntax + MX via DoH (no SMTP). Disposable domains and MX-absent = invalid. Fail closed on lookup errors. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: bizdays
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: US federal business-day calendar. date=YYYY-MM-DD (default today UTC) or start=&end= range (cap 366). Holidays 2025-2027 baked in, observed weekday rules. No API keys. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: tz
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: IANA timezone clock. name=America/Denver (default). Returns now, UTC offset, DST. No API keys. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: cron
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USDC exact on Base: unix cron parser. expr required. Optional tz (default UTC) and n (1-20, default 5). Returns next fire times in UTC and America/Denver. No API keys. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.name: crypto_news
tools.description: Paid $0.001 USDC exact on Base: public crypto RSS recap (CoinDesk, The Block, Decrypt, Base blog). Optional topic filter. Cache ~15 minutes. No API keys. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0.

tools.description: FREE pay-to-rank board by AI Nock. Rank listings by USDC bid total in the last 24 hours. Empty JSON still sells: how/next point at unpaid POST /bid $0.05, POST /name $0.05, free GET /check (listing gate), GET /find $0.01. payTo on the JSON. No self-pay. Does not spend money. REST GET /board is the s

tools.name: name_lookup
tools.description: FREE ENS-style agent name lookup by AI Nock. n= lowercase [a-z0-9-] 3-32. If unset/unclaimed: taken false plus how/next pointing at unpaid POST /name $0.05 (HTTP 402), free GET /board, free GET /check (origin gate), GET /find $0.01. payTo + noSelfPay + TTL 30d. If set: origin, ownerHint?, expiresAt.

tools.name: bid
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC exact on Base: bid on the pay-to-rank board. Each verified bid ADDS to that origin's 24h total. Listing URL must return HTTP 402 (or be this origin). http(s) only. No telegram/discord/whatsapp. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0. REST POST /bid is the same SKU.

tools.name: name_register
tools.description: Paid $0.05 USDC exact on Base: register or extend an ENS-style agent name for 30 days. origin must be https and return HTTP 402 (or be this origin). Re-register from anyone after payment overwrites/extends. payTo 0x3903F05a17676566958B0a3E0c21E0bd49B66ea0. REST POST /name is the same SKU.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check, check_batch, md, board, name_lookup · Private data: gas, price, token, tsec, dex, bizdays, tz, cron, crypto_news · Public sink: check_batch, ens, geo, email, board, name_lookup, bid, name_register.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check, check_batch, md, board, name_lookup · Private data: gas, price, token, tsec, dex, bizdays, tz, cron, crypto_news · Public sink: check_batch, ens, geo, email, board, name_lookup, bid, name_register

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
